about.title: About Component Tracker
about.subtitle: Information about the application, its purpose, and license.
about.intro: Component Tracker is a local-first inventory application designed for managing electronic components in a personal workshop or laboratory.
about.purpose.title: Purpose
about.purpose.text: The main goal of Component Tracker is to provide a simple, fast, and reliable way to keep track of electronic components without relying on cloud services or external accounts.
about.features.title: Key Features
about.features.item1: Centralized component list with search and filters
about.features.item3: Human-readable TXT and machine-readable CSV exports
about.features.item4: Local SQLite database stored on your machine
about.philosophy.title: Design Philosophy
about.philosophy.text: The application follows a simplicity-first approach: predictable behavior, stable URLs, no hidden state, and no unnecessary abstractions. All data stays local and under user control.
